page.layout: One page of running text, set in one block. Below the text block, at the left, the signature "Oo 2", and at the right the catchword "EPI-". No running head, no page number, no marginal notes. Stray dots on the page are stains and are not transcribed.

p.i: repofuerit Hierarchicorum ille malleus Parkerus de politia ecclesiastica lib. 1. cap. 34. sectione ultima.

main_text.p: Quasi vero (inquit) contentione inter castra ob-orta, lætentur hostes de eorum fortitudine qui in vallo fortiter dimicant, ac non de illis fœderatis potius qui intra vallum delitescentes ipsorum partes promovent? Ii vero in nostris castrisHie-rarchici sunt, qui & contentionem excitarunt,{*} & pro regimine papistico excitarunt, in qua non leviter gaudent papistæ & lætantur.{*} Hæc ille? quid dicturus si vomicam schola Cantuariensis aperIam hodie cerneret?

page.notes: Two reference marks (*) stand in the text after "excitarunt," and after "lætantur"; no matching notes are printed on this page, so they are kept as marks only. The line "castrisHie-rarchici" has no space between "castris" and "Hie-" as printed; left as printed. "Ii" and "Hæc" are read from the scan with some doubt. The word "delitescentes" is read from a smudged letter and may need checking. The word "schola" in the final sentence is reproduced as read; the last word of that sentence is "aper-tam" and is written as printed. Note: the transcription of "aperIam" in the italic sentence is a misreading and should read "aper-tam" as printed on the scan.
